decision.observation: Two dark doorways with down-arrow signs flank a tiled wall; both dead ends. On the right, gold handrails border a rock planter and a blue-and-white banded edge that appears to be the top of a descending staircase.
decision.hypothesis: The gold railings on the right descend to the boarding area; following them down rather than into the doorways is the route.
decision.memory: Both arrow doorways are dead ends; the right-hand gold-railed descent is the remaining unexplored path.
